meta.description: Open-source platform for SEO and AI search visibility (GEO/AEO)

common.previewHint: These screens are a design preview. Data connects to real sources from M1 on.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: A unified view of your SEO and AI visibility.
overview.emptyTitle: This project is not collecting data yet
overview.emptyBody: Connect your provider key and add keywords and prompts to track; the indicators fill in here.

aiSummary.title: AI Visibility
aiSummary.description: How visible your brand is in answers from ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI.
aiSummary.emptyBody: Build your prompt library to see mention rate, citation rate and share of voice per platform.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.description: The questions you track and the latest answer on each platform.
prompts.emptyBody: Add the questions your customers ask AI assistants; every run keeps the answer and its sources.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Domains and pages cited in AI answers.
sources.emptyBody: See which sites AI answers cite; the list is a starting point for partnerships and content opportunities.

competitors.title: Competitors
competitors.description: Your share of voice in AI answers against your competitors.
competitors.emptyBody: Add competitors and brand variations in project settings to compare share of voice and mention order.

rankTracker.title: Rank Tracker
rankTracker.description: Daily rankings of your keywords by location, language and device.
rankTracker.emptyBody: Add keywords; rankings, SERP features and whether AI Overviews cite you are recorded every day.

siteAudit.title: Site Audit
siteAudit.description: Technical SEO issues, site health and AI crawler access.
siteAudit.emptyBody: The first audit crawls your site following robots.txt and lists issues by severity.

backlinks.title: Backlinks
backlinks.description: Referring domains, anchors and new or lost links.
backlinks.emptyBody: The backlink profile and competitor comparisons come from the DataForSEO Backlinks API.

searchConsole.title: Search Console
searchConsole.description: Query and page performance from Google Search Console.
searchConsole.emptyBody: Connect your Google account to sync clicks, impressions and average position every day.

optimizer.title: Content Optimizer
optimizer.description: Content briefs and live scoring based on SERPs and AI citations.
optimizer.emptyBody: An editor that shows GEO and SEO scores while you write arrives in the last roadmap stage.

keywordExplorer.title: Keyword Explorer
keywordExplorer.description: Search volume, difficulty, intent and related keywords.
keywordExplorer.emptyTitle: Start your research with a keyword
keywordExplorer.emptyBody: Results come from DataForSEO Labs; the estimated cost of each search is shown before it runs.

domainOverview.title: Domain Overview
domainOverview.description: Organic visibility, traffic and competitors of any domain.
domainOverview.emptyBody: Organic keywords, estimated traffic and competing domains will be listed here.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Branded PDF reports and scheduled delivery.
reports.emptyBody: Create PDF reports with your own logo and email them to clients on a schedule.

projectSettings.title: Project Settings
projectSettings.description: Domain, default location and language, brand, competitors and integrations.
projectSettings.emptyBody: This page becomes active once project details, brand variations and competitors can be saved.

workspaceSettings.title: Workspace Settings
workspaceSettings.description: Members and roles, provider keys, usage and budget.
workspaceSettings.emptyBody: Invitations, encrypted provider keys and spending limits will be managed on this page.

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.description: Complete these steps so the project starts collecting data.

steps.keywords: Add keywords and prompts to track

design.title: Design System
design.description: Tokens and components used across the interface.
design.chartPaletteHint: Eight colors in a fixed order, validated for color vision deficiency and contrast. Your own brand is always color 1.
design.chartExampleHint: Sample data. Two series use a legend, a tooltip and a table view together.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for may have moved or never existed.

overview.aiTrendEmpty: Once prompt tracking starts, weekly visibility per platform is charted here.
overview.rankEmpty: Keywords are grouped into top 3, top 10 and top 100 here.
